name: How long does a typical ceiling drywall repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical ceiling drywall repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a ceiling drywall repair depends on the extent of the damage. Small patches might take a few hours to a day, including drying time for spackle or joint compound. Larger repairs involving replacing entire sections of drywall, multiple coats of compound, and texturing can take several days to a week. This timeline accounts for necessary drying times between applications to ensure a durable and smooth finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time varies from a few hours for small patches to several days for larger, more complex repairs.
